import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings
import time

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Extract features
target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
y_train = train_df[target_cols].values
X_train_text = train_df["comment_text"].fillna("")
X_test_text = test_df["comment_text"].fillna("")
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Set random seed
np.random.seed(42)

# Create hold-out validation split (20% val, rest for training)
n_samples = len(X_train_text)
indices = np.arange(n_samples)
np.random.shuffle(indices)

val_size = int(0.20 * n_samples)
val_indices = indices[:val_size]
train_indices = indices[val_size:]

X_val = X_train_text.iloc[val_indices]
y_val = y_train[val_indices]
X_tr = X_train_text.iloc[train_indices]
y_tr = y_train[train_indices]

# Fit vectorizer on training text only
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=50000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2, max_df=0.95, sublinear_tf=True
)
X_tr_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_tr)
X_val_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_test_text)

# Use shape[0] for sparse matrix size
n_train = X_tr_vec.shape[0]
n_val = X_val_vec.shape[0]
n_test = X_test_vec.shape[0]

print(
    f"Training vectors: {n_train}, Validation vectors: {n_val}, Test vectors: {n_test}"
)

models_final = {}

for col in target_cols:
    print(f"\nTraining model for: {col}")

    mod = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        objective="binary",
        metric="auc",
        verbose=-1,
        n_jobs=-1,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        num_leaves=31,
        max_depth=8,
        min_child_samples=20,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        reg_alpha=0.1,
        reg_lambda=0.1,
        random_state=42,
        n_estimators=200,
        force_col_wise=True,
    )

    start_time = time.time()

    # Use early stopping with validation set
    mod.fit(
        X_tr_vec,
        y_tr[:, target_cols.index(col)],
        eval_set=[(X_val_vec, y_val[:, target_cols.index(col)])],
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
    )

    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    print(f"Model trained in {elapsed:.2f} seconds")

    models_final[col] = mod

# Generate predictions on validation set first to compute metric
validation_predictions = np.zeros((n_val, len(target_cols)))
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    proba = models_final[col].predict_proba(X_val_vec)[:, 1]
    validation_predictions[:, i] = proba


# Compute validation metric (mean column-wise ROC AUC)
def compute_roc_auc(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    auc_scores = []
    for i in range(len(target_cols)):
        y_label = y_true[:, i]
        y_prob = y_pred_proba[:, i]
        try:
            if y_label.std() > 1e-8 and y_prob.std() > 1e-8:
                auc = roc_auc_score(y_label, y_prob)
                auc_scores.append(auc)
        except ValueError:
            continue
    return float(np.mean(auc_scores)) if auc_scores else 0.0


validation_metric = compute_roc_auc(y_val, validation_predictions)

# Generate predictions on test set
submissions = np.zeros((len(test_ids), len(target_cols)))
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    proba = models_final[col].predict_proba(X_test_vec)[:, 1]
    submissions[:, i] = proba

# Save submission to required path
sub_output = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids})
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    sub_output[col] = submissions[:, i]

output_path = "./submission/submission.csv"
sub_output.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

# Print only the validation metric as required
print(f"{validation_metric:.6f}")
